SEARCH
Package sc.fiji.snt.util

Class MeshUtils

java.lang.Object
sc.fiji.snt.util.MeshUtils
public final class MeshUtils extends Object
Utilities for converting masks, fills and trees to triangle meshes (Mesh) and for reading/writing meshes in Wavefront OBJ, PLY and STL formats.

All fromXXX methods expect 3D input (use Views.hyperSlice(net.imglib2.RandomAccessible, int, long) to select a channel or time-point) and return meshes in physical coordinates, i.e., origin + voxelIndex * spacing. This is the convention of SNT paths, so meshes align with reconstructions when spacing is the image calibration and origin is zero.

Author:
Tiago Ferreira

      public static <T extends net.imglib2.type.BooleanType<T>> net.imglib2.mesh.Mesh fromMask(net.imglib2.RandomAccessibleInterval<T> mask, double[] spacing, double[] origin, double smoothing)
      Converts a binary mask to a mesh.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the mask type
      Parameters:
      mask - the 3D mask. true voxels are foreground
      spacing - the voxel size (x, y, z). Null defaults to 1
      origin - the physical coordinates of voxel (0, 0, 0). Null defaults to 0
      smoothing - the sigma, in the units of spacing, of a Gaussian blur applied to the mask before meshing. 0 disables smoothing. Note that structures thinner than about twice this value (e.g., fills of thin neurites) shrink and may vanish
      Returns:
      the mesh (empty if the mask has no foreground)

    • fromTree

      public static net.imglib2.mesh.Mesh fromTree(Tree tree, double voxelSize, double isoLevel)
      Converts a tree to a mesh. The tree is rasterized with TreeToRaster (frustum geometry, so node radii are honored) into a partial-volume occupancy map, from which the iso-surface is extracted. Overlapping branches are merged into a single watertight surface, but be aware that:
      • Without node radii, TreeToRaster defaults to a radius of half a voxel, producing constant-width tubes.
      • A neurite thinner than about one voxel never reaches an occupancy of 0.5. Use a smaller isoLevel (e.g., 0.25) or a smaller voxel size for such cases.
      • The raster spans the bounding box of the tree, so very large trees require a coarser voxelSize.
      Parameters:
      tree - the tree to be converted
      voxelSize - the isotropic voxel size of the intermediate raster, in the tree's spatial units
      isoLevel - the occupancy (0-1 exclusive) at which the surface is placed. 0.5 places it at the nominal neurite boundary
      Returns:
      the mesh, in the coordinate system of the tree
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any argument is invalid or the intermediate raster would be too large

    • fromFills

      public static net.imglib2.mesh.Mesh fromFills(Collection<FillerThread> fillers, double[] spacing, double[] origin, double smoothing)
      Converts the union of one or more fills to a single mesh. Only voxels within each fill's threshold are included, as in FillConverter.convertBinary(net.imglib2.RandomAccessible<T>).
      Parameters:
      fillers - the fills
      spacing - see fromMask(net.imglib2.RandomAccessibleInterval<T>, double[], double[], double)
      origin - the physical coordinates of voxel (0, 0, 0) of the canvas the fills were computed on. Fill nodes are canvas pixel indices, so a canvas that does not start at the world origin (e.g., a crop) requires its offset
      smoothing - see fromMask(net.imglib2.RandomAccessibleInterval<T>, double[], double[], double)
      Returns:
      the mesh (empty if the fills have no voxels)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the bounding box of the fills is too large to be rasterized

    • readObj

      public static net.imglib2.mesh.Mesh readObj(InputStream in) throws IOException
      Reads a Wavefront OBJ. Only geometry is read: vertices (v) and faces (f), with polygons triangulated as fans. Normals, texture coordinates, materials and object/group boundaries are ignored, so multi-object files are merged into a single mesh. Vertex order is preserved. Face indices may be 1-based or negative (relative) and may include texture/normal references (v/vt/vn).
      Parameters:
      in - the stream to read. Closed by the caller
      Returns:
      the mesh
      Throws:
      IOException - if the content could not be read or parsed

    • saveAsObj

      public static File saveAsObj(Map<String,net.imglib2.mesh.Mesh> meshes, Map<String,MeshUtils.Material> materials, File file) throws IOException
      Saves several meshes to a single Wavefront OBJ file, each as a named object (o statement), with optional colors. Per-vertex normals are written for all meshes. If materials is not empty, a companion .mtl file (same name as the OBJ file) is also written, and objects with an entry in materials reference it.
      Parameters:
      meshes - the meshes to be saved, mapped by object name
      materials - the materials, mapped by object name (the same keys as meshes). Null or empty to not write colors
      file - the destination. .obj is appended if missing
      Returns:
      the file written
      Throws:
      IOException - if a file could not be written
